messages:
michael (SRE): quick async standup — what I did / blockers / today

michael (SRE): Did: validated the new alert threshold for kv-store errors, rolled out to canary (region us-west-2).

michael (SRE): Blocker: observed brief spike in 5xxs when concurrency > 1200 on canary nodes, need to confirm it's not a client retry storm.

anya (oncall): saw the spike in grafana, looks like a few tenants had heavy retry loops. I quarantined 3 IPs and muted the noisy alerts.

devin: FYI I pushed a small change to backoff in svc-client: https://git.internal/r/redwood/svc-client/pull/482

tina (pager): Did: followed up with ops to confirm quota bump for dedicated pool; Done: updated runbook step for quota escalation.

michael (SRE): Today: run load repro on staging with replay + trace sampling to capture retry pattern. Can someone keep an eye on canary?

anya (oncall): I'm on it for the next 2h, will post updates. I also updated the alert: slo_error_rate -> rate over 5m instead of 1m.

jorge: quick question — does the backoff change require a migration? or just roll forward?

devin: no migration, just bump lib version. will add a changelog entry.

ci-bot: Build passed for svc-client@feature/retry-backoff (job #1234) :white_check_mark:

michael (SRE): Also: small doc tweak — added troubleshooting steps under eng-sre/runbooks/kv-errors.md (internal link)

anya (oncall): Blocker for me: customer A reported degraded latency for embeddings endpoints during the spike. I've opened ticket #TI-909.

tina (pager): I can pair with you later to collect traces for them. 16:30 PT works?

anya (oncall): 16:30 PT good. I'll drop the log links into the ticket before then.

michael (SRE): Action items: (1) devin to ship backoff PR (2) michael to run repro + collect traces (3) anya/tina follow up with customer traces. ETA EOD.

devin: shipping in 20m, will ping when prod rollout starts :rocket:

anya (oncall): after rollout I'll unmute alerts and monitor 15m window.

tina (pager): if we still see >1% SLO violations, escalate to oncall lead @michael.

michael (SRE): thanks — will keep hangout open for the repro if needed. ping me with trace IDs.

devin: rolling out now

ci-bot: Deploy to prod started: svc-client v1.12.3 -> v1.12.4 (canary 10%)

anya (oncall): canary steady for 10m, no new 5xxs seen. I'll advance to 50% in 15.

michael (SRE): nice. when you advance, add note to runbook about rollback flag: --no-retry-experimental

anya (oncall): noted.

devin: advanced to 50% — monitoring.

ci-bot: Deploy success: svc-client v1.12.4 promoted to 100% :tada:

anya (oncall): monitoring after promo: looks good, embedding latency back to baseline.

michael (SRE): closing loop — will update the postmortem template with retry-surge checklist (low urgency doc).

tina (pager): thanks all. nothing else from me.

michael (SRE): thumbs if you saw this and no blockers :thumbsup:

anya (oncall): 👍

devin: 👍

jorge: 👍
